fact: Car 30 allegedly collided with Car 23 at turn 1.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Articles 2 b) and 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing and in-car video evidence and determined that Car 30 (Lawson) was overtaking Car 23 (Albon) on the outside at Turn 1 and was well ahead of Car 23 at the apex. While defending, Car 23 collided with the rear of Car 30 suffering damage to its front wing. The collision was not the fault of Car 30. We therefore took no furher action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
